title: SGD with momentum
summary: One momentum update with the lesson's velocity rule, and a loop that minimizes a quadratic with or without Nesterov lookahead.

mutants.ema_velocity: Scales the gradient by 1 minus beta, so the velocity is an average and not the lesson's sum.
mutants.old_velocity_update: Moves the parameters with the old velocity and not the new velocity.
mutants.lookahead_sign: Computes the Nesterov gradient at x plus lr times beta times v, the wrong side.
mutants.grad_sign: Uses b minus A x as the gradient, so the loop climbs away from the minimum.
mutants.in_place_velocity: Updates the velocity in place with *= and +=, so the caller's velocity array changes.
